Definition: probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of G5114; the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon):--edge, face, mouth.
BiblicalUsage: The mouth speaks what the heart is full of. Out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh, a good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good, and if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart, thou shalt be saved.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mouth is the heart's witness: what fills it comes out, and confessing the Lord is how the heart's faith speaks.
